rule: credited minutes, the Zeitkonto balance, Berlin calendar-month periods, daily targets, opening dates, policy versions, period results and payroll export rows

exempt.lib/time-accounts/access.ts: Server reader of the caller's identity and management rights; it computes no time.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/action-support.ts: Role refusal, failure codes and a strict integer parse for the Server Actions.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/actions.ts: Server Actions: authorize, parse and call the database; time rules live in calculation.ts and in SQL.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/decision-actions.ts: Server Actions that record finding and adjustment decisions; the four-eyes rule lives in SQL.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/decision-reads.ts: Server readers of approval targets and decisions; they compute no time.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/defaults.ts: Constant default rule rows; calculation.ts applies them and its property draws every credit context.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/live-tables.ts: The tables whose changes refresh the period pages.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/messages.ts: German failure messages of the actions.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/opening-reads.ts: Server reader of opening-date facts; the date rules live in opening-dates.ts.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/overview-queries.ts: Server reader of the Zeitkonto overview; balances come stored from the closed periods.
Server steps that reserve, build and fail an export; rows come from payroll-export-rows.ts and bytes from export.ts.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/payroll-export-sources: Server reader of a closed period version's export sources.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/payroll-mapping-server: Server read and save of a mapping version; the code rules live in payroll-mapping.ts.
Groups stored findings into cards with their fix links; it computes no time.
Server reader that sums period-daily-targets.ts school minutes for the review.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/presentation.ts: Labels and display formats; formatMinutes' round trip with the typed balance is a property of balance-input.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/queries.ts: Server readers of periods, results and settings; they compute no time.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/read-support.ts: Server read helpers: regions, profiles and names.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/types.ts: Types of the Zeitkonto, period and export models only.
exempt.lib/time-accounts/validation.ts: Presence and JSON guards and a from-until order check for policy assignments.
